notes.title: Cosmetics Update - Early Access v0.8
notes.notes:
Cosmetics Update
I'm sorry it took so long, but here it is!

Item Types

 Skin
 Hats
 Hair
 Face
 Chest
 Legs
 Feet

Item Drops (might change later)

 [Common] Every Day!
 [Rare] Every 5 days!
 [Legendary] Every week!

Note: You need to play to get items!


Weekly Voted Item
For the next couple of weeks I will add some items that are voted on in the Discord server.
If you would like to vote: https://discord.gg/hUbzJCDXD2.


Item Store
It is possible to buy items in the item store (if you would like to support me).

Note: If you have bought a new item, you might need to restart the game to unlock it!
